description: Frozen coordinates in metres over a 100-by-100 m square (2026-09-30: every x and y coordinate of the original 50-by-50 m bank, i.e. BSs, UE drops and STAR setups, multiplied by 2; heights and azimuths unchanged). Original K=8,12,16,20 UE drops from 2026-09-17 are unchanged; K=10,14,18 added 2026-09-18. No runtime network sampling. UE matrices stack K rows/drop; STAR matrices stack L rows/setup. Exactly three hand-designed STAR setups per L. Angles store one azimuth column in radians, bounded by [-pi/2,pi/2]; elevation is zero.

definitions.even: Two centroids of equal-area 50-by-100 strips; geometric coverage baseline, not a proven radio optimum.
definitions.tilted: Both BSs near the west side.
definitions.random: Independent uniform locations over the full square. Same coordinates for both BS layouts.
definitions.clustered: Two or three shared Gaussian cluster centres per drop; standard deviation 5.6 m (2.8 m before the 2x horizontal scaling), truncated to the square. Same coordinates for both BS layouts.
definitions.outlier: Exactly one designated edge UE within 1.6 m of a corner farthest from its nearest BS; other UEs within 10 m of a BS (0.8 m and 5 m before the 2x horizontal scaling). Coverage edge is geometric (no SINR coverage threshold assumed).
definitions.overloaded: K-1 UEs within 8 m of a single BS, one within 8 m of the other (4 m before the 2x horizontal scaling); hot BS alternates by drop.

extensionGeneration.seedRule: baseSeed + 10000*K + 1000*categoryIndex + 100*layoutIndex; categoryIndex=0:3; layoutIndex=0 for shared random/clustered, 0=even/1=tilted otherwise

horizontalScaling.applies: x and y of BS, UE and STAR coordinates; z, azimuths, dmin, d0, zmin, zmax unchanged
horizontalScaling.note: Drops, orderings and generation seeds are those of the 50-by-50 bank; coordinateDecimals refers to the unscaled values.
